column1: # The cross-language port-naming contract, one production per line,
# fields tab-separated. tapacc spells the C++ names, tapa-core projects
# them to RTL identifiers, and Vitis HLS names the generated RTL ports
# the runtime must bind to. Consumed by:
#   tapacc/codegen/conventions_test.cpp             C++ spellings
#   tapa-core/tapa-ir/src/port.rs                   RTL projection
#   tapa-core/tapa-codegen/.../instance/tests.rs    direct-offset probe
#   fpga-runtime/frt-cosim/src/tb/mod.rs            direct-offset probe
# The two primary consumers (conventions_test.cpp, port.rs) fail on any
# production they do not recognize, so this file can only change in
# lockstep with both languages.
# offset_name <base> <name>: the scalar base-address parameter an
# `mmap` argument lowers to.
offset_name
offset_name
# array_channel <base> <i> <cpp> <rtl> <offset>: the i-th channel of an
# `mmaps`/`streams` interface — its C++ spelling, the RTL identifier
# that spelling collapses to, and its flat offset parameter.
array_channel
array_channel
# fifo_var / peek_var <name> <member>: the internal FIFO members of a
# stream in rewritten task code.
fifo_var
peek_var
# mangled_prefix <value>: prefix for mangled task symbols, so an
# emitted name never starts with '_' (which Vitis rejects).
mangled_prefix
# direct_offset_port <base> <candidates...>: the RTL scalar port of an
# `offset=direct` `m_axi` argument, in probe order — Vitis HLS through
# 2024.2 spells it `<base>_offset`; 2025.1+ renamed it `<base>_r`.
# Consumers that find no candidate fall back to the first spelling.
direct_offset_port
